Title: The Real Reason Your Underarms Look Darker in Tank Top Season

Description:
Tank top season means your underarms are out - and if they look darker than the rest of your skin, dermatology clinics see this complaint constantly. Shaving with a dull blade or against the grain, fragrance and dyes in deodorant (especially right after shaving), and tight sweat-soaked workout gear can all trigger the same friction-driven pigmentation response.

Watch to find out why these three habits cause dark underarms, and the easy swaps that don't mean giving up shaving or your workout routine.
